text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Maru-chan. To deliver 'love' to the 
whole world... I'm thinking of setting my 
sights on racing overseas, too♪"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, as expected of my childhood friend♪ 
You see right through me. And so... I'd be 
so happy if you joined in too, Maru-chan♡"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
“—Helping my beloved Love-chan achieve her 
dream. ...That was the beginning of my 
'DREAMS.'”

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
We trained so much, watched the BC races, 
and got all fired up saying, 'Let's all 
win together!'

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"With this team, I really feel like we can 
win!" ...I had started to think like that. 
But—

text_block_list.name: Desire & Espo
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah! Ora ora oraaa!

text_block_list.name: Spectating Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ready, and... "DREAMS", do your best!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. The crowd's been growing day by 
day, too♪

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. Everyone's proven their track 
record so far. I think they believe we can 
do it at the BC too..."

text_block_list.name: Spectating Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Go get 'em, Marche-chan!

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Lady
text_block_list.text:
Marche-chan, Marche-chan! I heard you're 
running in a big race in America? 
Everyone's cheering for you, so give it 
your all!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
Gah!? ...Heh, "Ehehe♪ You're right. I'll 
do my best together with Love-chan♪"

text_block_list.name: Cocky Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yo! Our class's very own American Dream! 
I'll be watching live, so give it your 
all!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"No need to worry! Love-chan is definitely 
going to win!"

text_block_list.name: Cocky Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? You're in it 
too, right, Maru-chan? If anything, you're 
my favorite to win! No doubt about it! All 
of Japan has high hopes for you!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Huh...? S... 'Really~? Ahaha! Root for me 
then, okay?♪'"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
(Me...? Not Love-chan, or anyone else? 
B-But...)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone is watching with high 
expectations...? People from the academy, 
the city, all over the world... watching 
me...!?)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: Guhhh...!

text_block_list.name: VR System Voice
text_block_list.text:
"‘Dirt 1,800m, clocked time: 1 minute 
49.97 seconds. 8th place. Ending 
simulation program.’"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. Your times have been dropping 
lately. Perhaps it's best to focus on 
resting your mind and body for now.
choice_data_list: Get plenty of rest this weekend.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yes.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"...Our extensive race preparations paid 
off, and everyone should have built up the 
strength to hold their own in VR 
simulations, but..."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Having come this far, Marche-san's 
performance alone has been gradually 
declining.
choice_data_list:
I just hope resting over the weekend will 
help things get back to normal...

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
(The closer the real race gets... the 
heavier my legs feel.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With the BC drawing near, Loves Only You 
was commended by the URA in recognition of 
her performance over the past year."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Commendable! Most auspicious ahead of the 
expedition! Furthermore, along with the 
certificate of merit, there is also a 
gift! Please, accept it!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "Love-chan, congratulations!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Maru-chan...!?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Ho... so the gift was a racing Racewear. 
And to think it was designed by 
Marche-san.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Fufun♪ I'm actually pretty confident when 
it comes to artistic sense! You know, 
designing, illustrating, and all that!"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Ah, now that you mention it, Loves' 
streaming assets are Marche's art too, 
right? You really put your heart into it, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! Because I thought... maybe all that 
effort I put into designing and drawing 
was... all for this moment."

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"You see, Love-chan is an Umamusume who 
tries her best to return the love of every 
single person walking beside her..."

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"‘Receiving the love of their cheers, and 
returning that love as victory to everyone 
who supported her. That is Love-chan's 
form of "Love".’"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"And now, Love-chan's love has reached all 
the way to fans across all of Japan—"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
“We've finally reached the point where the 
world is within our grasp. The point where 
Love-chan's dream—to fill the whole world 
with love—can truly come true.”

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"‘That's why... I wanted to design 
something special myself, worthy of 
fulfilling our dream.’"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
I see, so it's for the sake of your 
precious close friend. Fufu. I can't wait 
to see this—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting♪ Fufu. ...How do I 
look?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My goodness...! How magnificent and full 
of grace...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...!? Now that's a seriously gorgeous 
one...!
choice_data_list: That's nice, it's a lovely outfit.
Looks great, that's a wonderful outfit.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"‘The giant flower is—Love-chan's dream. A 
grand flower blooming on the world's 
greatest stage.’"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
""The scattered little flowers represent 
everyone's dreams. So many feelings 
walking alongside Love-chan...""

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"The moment Love-chan's dream comes true, 
everyone's feelings... my feelings will 
bloom right alongside it."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
(............Yeah. I'm so glad I got to 
see this smile from Love-chan.)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe the way I am now really is—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (...Maru-chan...?)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(――...Maru-chan's simulated race data has 
plunged sharply recently. Could this 
be...)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Um, Casino-san. Regarding Maru-chan—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that matter has been troubling me 
as well. She isn't injured, so I suspect 
it might be a mental issue, but...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (...Mental state... Could it be—)

text_block_list.name: Cocky Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah... come to think of it, Maru-chan 
seemed unusually flustered back then...? 
Did I put too much pressure on her...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(............ I knew it. The time when her 
performance in mock races dropped matches 
up with the timing of that story.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (Maru-chan... What are you thinking...?)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
My legs feel heavy, as if gravity itself 
has increased.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: ...I'm scared.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: I'm... scared...

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
A single puppet I made when I was little. 
A wonderful, wonderful talking puppet.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
Comical and thoughtful. Bright, fun, and 
truly worthy of being everyone's favorite. 
That other—'me.'

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
Even though I'm not good at talking, as 
long as 'I' am here, I'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"The bright and cheerful 'me' will always 
live up to everyone's expectations!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And before I knew it, I couldn't have any 
conversation with anyone other than myself 
without using my puppets...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Still, races were the sole exception. 
While running, Maru-chan didn't need any 
puppets."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Joy. Frustration. Winning. Not wanting to 
lose. A place where everyone bares their 
feelings without holding back. Because in 
a race, words were never needed.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Maru-chan was always so full of life 
whenever she got caught up in racing.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
But this time... the Breeders' Cup is 
different from before... Even telling 
someone like me, "You can become the best 
in the world"...

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"...I know. If I don't cast aside all 
hesitation, it won't even be a contest. 
But—"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
I'm scared... I'm so scared, Love-chan... 
To ask someone like me, who just hides 
behind a puppet, to do that—

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
There's no way anyone could handle such 
immense expectations and 
disappointments...

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Still! When I saw how happy Love-chan 
looked smiling in the racing silks I 
designed, it hit me!"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"I'm already helping Love-chan achieve her 
dream! So maybe there's no need to show a 
side of myself I hate just to win...!"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
Because Love-chan can definitely win at 
the BC! As long as Love-chan wins, my 
dream will come true! Me and everyone else 
will be happy—

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"I'm... fine even if I don't win the BC. 
Things are fine the way they are. That's—"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: —It's fine not to change.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Hey, Maru-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"If Maru-chan really feels that way, 
then—"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Marche-san's drop in motivation... It 
could end up affecting the whole team.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since last autumn, we've moved 
forward with the vow to win together, so 
for someone to halt their steps mentally 
is a grave matter for the team.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Especially to the one who has known Marche 
Lorraine the longest.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Either way, we need to take some 
countermeasure immediately—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Could you... leave it to me? Maru-chan, 
that is.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Maru-chan is my best friend. This is 
something... I have to do."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Please tell me your thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood. Then let's leave March-san 
to Loves-san."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I'm sure I'll make 
this work somehow.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
Loves-chan... You told me to wear my 
racing outfit because we'd record races 
for a video, but...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "...Maru-chan. Let me ask you one thing."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Even if I win the BC and you lose, 
Maru-chan... ...will you be satisfied with 
that?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!? H-How do you know about that...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...I knew it. I can tell. After all, we've 
always been together.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
...I... As long as... Love-chan is happy, 
I...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...I see. If that's the case... today will 
be the last day... I ever wear this.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Because this outfit has to be something 
where our dreams become one."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
At last year's BC, we all agreed to "win 
together," right?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
From that moment on, my dream changed to 
"winning together with everyone, and 
delivering love to the world."

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
If you truly don't want to, I won't force 
you. But—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
If you share this dream, then run with me. 
Show me your serious running, Maru-chan. 
That's what—I'm expecting from you.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Start!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
(How many times have I chased after 
Love-chan like this? I've already lost 
count...)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
(Still... the Love-chan of today can take 
on the world... She can win and deliver 
love to everyone. With how weak-willed I 
am, I can't fight alongside her.)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
(So go on...! From here on, you're on your 
own...!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(There's no sign of Maru-chan moving up... 
Are you... really giving up...?)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(Really... can I never run with all my 
might again?)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(I have... no choice but to go alone 
now... do I?)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay! The winner of the kids' race is... 
1st place on turf, Loves Only You-chan!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Taking 1st place on the dirt was Marche 
Lorraine!

text_block_list.name: Young Loves
text_block_list.text:
Yay♪ First prize, one step at a time, 
right♪

text_block_list.name: Young Marche
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah... Because we did a lot of training 
together...!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Strong, beautiful, cute, and cool. I want 
to run alongside Love-chan just like 
that."

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
Reaching out, wanting to get even a little 
closer. Just to be near that brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
If I run beside her like that, we can get 
strong together, and someday, I'll be able 
to sparkle too.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
If I run beside her like that, we can 
elevate each other, and I'm sure we can 
keep getting stronger endlessly.

text_block_list.name: Loves & Marche
text_block_list.text:
"That's why we've run together all this 
time, but... That's why we've run together 
all this time, and yet."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to... become the best in the 
world with Maru-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I've been right by your side ever since 
we met! In the kids' races, and all the 
way until we entered Tracen Academy... 
We've always been together...!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I need Maru-chan to deliver love to the 
world! So... please...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Run with me... please...! Maru-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
(Why did I try to stop? If I don't reach 
out from the closest place of all... I'll 
never shine like Love-chan.)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
(If I stop here... I'll never be able to 
reach out for that sparkle ever again, 
yet...)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
(Just watching from afar won't cut it...! 
I have to become like Love-chan...!)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
(Even if Love-chan becomes the best in the 
world, I'll run by her side forever...! If 
it's for that, baring the real me is—)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: I'm not... scaaaared at aaaaall...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...! I can hear it... I can feel it... 
Maru-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Loves & Marche
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"...*pant*... *gasp*... I knew it... This 
is how... Love-chan's running ought to 
be."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... If anything, that goes for you, 
Maru-chan. I could tell your aura had 
shifted. Thanks to that, even my own legs 
felt lighter.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I love the everyday Maru-chan, but I love 
the racing Maru-chan too. She's just so 
remarkably strong.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I can't afford to lose... It 
fills me with strength, making me want to 
run a race I can be proud of."

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
...! Carrying the hopes of all of Japan... 
It really is terrifying after all.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
Still, I want to live up to Love-chan's 
expectations... I want to answer them... 
That's why—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Just like we've always done, 
let's push each other higher and take on 
the world. And together... let's make our 
dream come true.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh... uuu...! Waaaaaahhhhh...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"We're in this together. Only when 
everyone devotes themselves to the same 
goal can great things be accomplished."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
No one will mock the sight of you 
there—they will only praise it. Yes, 
absolutely no one.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Heh. What the heck, it's already sorted 
out? Wasted my time worrying.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Huh. So you were worried... I see, I see~♪

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I-It's just a figure of speech! Stop 
picking on my words!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah, by overcoming this great trial, 
Marche-san has achieved a true awakening! 
May the Saint's blessing be upon you...!
choice_data_list:
It really was a great run. Your best one 
yet.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
...Um... 'I—will win. I'll definitely 
win.'

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. That's why I'd like to do it 
without the puppet, even in front of 
everyoneâ¡

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"L-Let's just save that for... someday in 
the future!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From that point on, Marche Lorraine 
regained her form, and "DREAMS" finally 
achieved completion as a true team.
